newsitem.title: CHILE: ING Barings upgrades Endesa to buy.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings upgrades Endesa to buy.

text.p: ING Barings said it has upgraded Chilean power giant Endesa to buy from hold, citing strong earnings growth and potential price appreciation.
"Following 12 months of market underperformance, Endesa has significant upside potential not yet reflected in the stock's price," said Pablo Salcedo, head of Chile equity research.

The company should see earnings growth of nearly 60 percent next year as normal rainfall is expected in coming southern hemisphere winter months which should increase water levels in the firm's reservoirs, said the report.
The drought has cut into profits as hydroelectric generators have been forced to buy more expensive power from fossil fuel generators as their dams dry up.
